name: Admin Outbound Email Copy Trace
description: Admin expands any primary outbound-email history row and sees every internal BCC recipient, including sent, failed and deduplicated/skipped attempts with independent detail. The primary result remains separate and is not duplicated as another top-level history row. El historial del cliente y el global comparten las etiquetas Enviado/Fallido para sent/failed sin alterar el estado real.
